en.s: The Battle of Ashdown was a West Saxon victory over a Danish Viking army on about 8 January 871. The location of Ashdown is not known, but may be Kingstanding Hill in Berkshire. Other writers place the battle near Starveall, a short distance north of the village of Aldworth and south east of Lowbury Hill. The West Saxons were led by King Æthelred and his younger brother, the future King Alfred the Great, while the Viking commanders were Bagsecg and Halfdan. The battle is described in the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle and Asser's Life of King Alfred.

zh.s: 约在871年1月8日，西撒克逊军队在阿什当击败丹麦维京军队。战场确切位置不明，可能是伯克郡的金斯坦丁山；另有作者认为在奥尔德沃思村北面不远、洛伯里山东南的斯塔沃尔附近。西撒克逊一方由埃塞尔雷德国王及其弟、后来的阿尔弗雷德大帝率领，维京一方则由巴格塞格和哈夫丹指挥。《盎格鲁-撒克逊编年史》及阿瑟所著《阿尔弗雷德国王传》均记载了此战。

en.s: The Sack of Somnath in 6–8 January 1026 was a military campaign orchestrated by Mahmud of Ghazni, the ruler of the Ghaznavid Empire, against the Chaulukya dynasty of Gujarat. This is considered Mahmud's fifteenth invasion of India, which saw strategic captures and battles that culminated in the destruction of the revered Somnath Temple. Facing staunch resistance, Mahmud's forces emerged victorious, resulting in significant casualties.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1026年1月6日至8日，加兹尼王朝统治者马哈茂德对古吉拉特的乔卢基亚王朝发动军事行动，最终劫掠索姆纳特。这通常被视为他第十五次入侵印度。行动经历多次攻占与战斗，最终摧毁了备受尊崇的索姆纳特神庙。尽管遭到顽强抵抗，马哈茂德的军队仍取得胜利，造成重大伤亡。

en.t: François Grimaldi, disguised as a monk, leads his men to capture the fortress protecting the Rock of Monaco, establishing his family as the rulers of Monaco
en.s: Francesco Grimaldi (French: François; English: Francis), called il Malizia (from Italian: "the malicious") was the Genoese leader of the Guelphs who captured the Rock of Monaco on the night of 8 January 1297. He was the son of Guglielmo Grimaldi by his wife Giacobina or Giacoba, a Genoese noble.

zh.t: 弗朗索瓦·格里马尔迪假扮修士，率部夺取摩纳哥岩上的堡垒，开启家族对摩纳哥的统治
zh.s: 弗朗切斯科·格里马尔迪，法语称弗朗索瓦、英语称弗朗西斯，绰号 il Malizia，意为“狡诈者”，是热那亚的教皇派领袖。他于1297年1月8日夜间夺取摩纳哥岩。他的父亲是古列尔莫·格里马尔迪，母亲是热那亚贵族贾科比娜，又名贾科巴。

en.s: The French siege of Calais in early 1558 was part of the Italian War of 1551–1559 between France and England and their respective allies. It resulted in the seizure of the town and its dependencies by France. The Pale of Calais had been ruled by England since 1347, during the Hundred Years' War. By the 1550s, England was ruled by Mary I and her husband Philip II of Spain.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1558年初的加来围城战是1551—1559年意大利战争的一部分，交战双方是法国、英格兰及其各自的盟友。法国最终夺取加来及其附属地区。加来辖区自百年战争期间的1347年起由英格兰统治。到了16世纪50年代，英格兰由玛丽一世及其丈夫、西班牙国王腓力二世共同统治。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Swedish invasion of Kexholm occurred during the Long Wrath between Russia and Sweden from late 1572 to early 1573. A Swedish force from Viborg under the command of Herman Fleming entered Kexholm, destroying almost all of the 400 buildings there, along with killing anyone they encountered.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 瑞典入侵凯克斯霍尔姆（1572年）
zh.s: 瑞典入侵凯克斯霍尔姆发生在1572年底至1573年初，属于俄瑞战争（Long Wrath）期间的行动。赫尔曼·弗莱明率瑞典军队从维堡出发，进入凯克斯霍尔姆，几乎摧毁当地全部400座建筑，并杀害所遇到的人。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Stromboli, also known as the Second Battle of Stromboli or the Battle of Alicudi, took place on 8 January, 1676, during the Franco-Dutch War. The battle occurred between a French fleet of 20 ships under Abraham Duquesne and a combined fleet of 19 allied ships (18 Dutch and one Spanish ship) under Lieutenant-Admiral-General Michiel de Ruyter. It lasted eight hours and ended inconclusively.

zh.s: 斯特龙博利海战又称第二次斯特龙博利海战或阿利库迪海战，于1676年1月8日发生，是法荷战争的一部分。亚伯拉罕·迪凯纳率领20艘法国军舰，与米希尔·德·鲁伊特海军中将军率领的19艘盟军舰艇交战，后者包括18艘荷兰舰和一艘西班牙舰。战斗持续八小时，未分胜负。

en.t: Handel’s Ariodante premieres at Covent Garden
en.s: George Frideric Handel’s opera Ariodante received its first performance at Covent Garden Theatre in London on 8 January 1735. It opened his first season at that theatre.
en.n: This entry concerns the opera’s first performance, rather than the composer’s life dates.

zh.t: 亨德尔歌剧《阿里奥丹特》在科文特花园首演
zh.s: 1735年1月8日，乔治·弗里德里希·亨德尔的歌剧《阿里奥丹特》在伦敦科文特花园剧院首次上演。这部作品揭开了他在该剧院首个演出季的序幕。
zh.n: 此条记录涉及歌剧首演，而非作曲家的生卒日期。

en.s: The action of 8 January 1780 was a naval encounter off Cape Finisterre between a British Royal Naval fleet under Admiral Sir George Rodney, and a fleet of Spanish merchants sailing in convoy with seven warships of the Guipuzcoan Caracas Company, under the command of Commodore Don Juan Augustin de Yardi. During the action the entire Spanish convoy was captured.

zh.s: 1780年1月8日，在菲尼斯特雷角外海，乔治·罗德尼海军上将率领的英国皇家海军舰队，与胡安·奥古斯丁·德亚尔迪海军准将指挥的西班牙商船护航队交战。西班牙船队由加拉加斯吉普斯夸纳公司的七艘军舰护航。战斗中，整支西班牙船队被俘。

en.s: The Battle of Blaauwberg, also known as the Battle of Cape Town, fought near Cape Town on 8 January 1806, was a small but significant military engagement. It established British rule in South Africa, which was to have many ramifications for the region during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries. A bi-centennial commemoration was held in January 2006.

zh.s: 1806年1月8日，布劳堡战役在开普敦附近展开，也称开普敦战役。战斗规模虽小，却确立了英国在南非的统治，对该地区19世纪和20世纪的发展带来诸多影响。2006年1月，人们举行了战役两百周年纪念活动。

en.s: The 1811 German Coast uprising was a slave rebellion which occurred in the Territory of Orleans on January 8–10, 1811. It occurred on the east bank of the Mississippi River in the modern-day Louisiana parishes of St. John the Baptist, St. Charles and Jefferson. The rebellion was the largest of its kind in the history of the United States.

zh.s: 1811年1月8日至10日，奥尔良领地爆发德国海岸奴隶起义。事发地区位于密西西比河东岸，今天属于路易斯安那州的施洗者圣约翰县、圣查尔斯县和杰斐逊县。这是美国历史上规模最大的奴隶起义。

en.s: On January 8, 1814 a contingent of 70 Americans led by General John Swift attacked a group of British soldiers gathering wood a half-mile from Fort Niagara.

zh.s: 1814年1月8日，约翰·斯威夫特将军率领70名美国人，袭击了在尼亚加拉堡外半英里处收集木材的一队英国士兵。

en.s: The Battle of New Orleans was fought on January 8, 1815, between the British Army under Major General Sir Edward Pakenham and the United States Army under Brevet Major General Andrew Jackson, roughly 5 miles (8 km) southeast of the French Quarter of New Orleans, in the current suburb of Chalmette, Louisiana. The battle was the climax of the five-month Gulf Campaign (September 1814 to February 1815) by Britain to try to take New Orleans, West Florida, and possibly the Louisiana Territory which began at the First Battle of Fort Bowyer.

zh.s: 1815年1月8日，爱德华·帕肯汉姆爵士少将率领的英军，与安德鲁·杰克逊名誉少将指挥的美军交战。战场位于新奥尔良法国区东南约五英里、即八公里，今路易斯安那州沙尔梅特郊区。这是英国海湾战役的高潮：该战役从第一次鲍耶堡战役开始，于1814年9月至1815年2月持续约五个月，英军试图夺取新奥尔良、西佛罗里达，并可能进一步夺取路易斯安那领地。

en.s: On 8 January 1835, United States president Andrew Jackson announced a celebratory dinner after the national debt had been paid off.

en.s: The Battle of Río San Gabriel was fought on 8 January 1847 during the California campaign of the Mexican–American War. It took place at a ford of the San Gabriel River, at what are today parts of the cities of Whittier, Pico Rivera and Montebello, about ten miles south-east of downtown Los Angeles.

zh.s: 圣加布里埃尔河战役于1847年1月8日爆发，是美墨战争加利福尼亚战役的一部分。战场位于圣加布里埃尔河的一处浅滩，约在洛杉矶市中心东南十英里处，今天分别属于惠蒂尔、皮科里韦拉和蒙特贝洛三座城市。

en.s: The 1848–49 Massachusetts gubernatorial election consisted of an initial popular election held on November 13, 1848 that was followed by a legislative vote held on January 8, 1849. Incumbent Whig Governor George N. Briggs was reelected.

zh.s: 1848—1849年马萨诸塞州州长选举先于1848年11月13日举行民众投票，随后于1849年1月8日由州议会投票。辉格党现任州长乔治·N.布里格斯成功连任。

en.s: The Battle of Roan's Tan Yard (also known as Silver Creek) was an action during the American Civil War, occurring on January 8, 1862, in Randolph County, Missouri. Rumors and sightings of a Confederate force in the Howard County area had circulated for more than a week, but the Union troops could not locate them. On January 7, 1862, information was received that Col. John A. Poindexter and his force of 800 Missouri State Guard recruits were camped on Silver Creek. Detachments from various Union units came together and headed towards the Confederate camp which was about 14 miles northwest of Fayette.

zh.s: 1862年1月8日，美国内战中的罗恩制革场战役在密苏里州伦道夫县爆发，也称银溪战役。此前一个多星期，霍华德县一带不断传出发现邦联军的消息，但联邦军始终未能找到他们。1月7日，联邦军获悉，约翰·A.波因德克斯特上校及其800名密苏里州卫队新兵驻扎在银溪。联邦军从不同部队抽调分队集合，前往位于费耶特西北约14英里的敌军营地。

en.s: The Second Battle of Springfield was a battle in the American Civil War fought January 8, 1863, in Springfield, Missouri. It is sometimes known as The Battle of Springfield. (The First Battle of Springfield was fought on October 25, 1861, and there was also the better-known Battle of Wilson's Creek, fought nearby on August 10, 1861.) Fighting was urban and house-to-house, which was rare in the war.

zh.t: 第二次斯普林菲尔德战役
zh.s: 1863年1月8日，美国内战中的第二次斯普林菲尔德战役在密苏里州斯普林菲尔德展开，有时也简称斯普林菲尔德战役。第一次同名战役发生于1861年10月25日，更著名的威尔逊溪战役则于1861年8月10日在附近进行。第二次战役采用了当时战争中较为罕见的城市巷战，交战双方逐屋争夺。

en.s: The Battle of Dove Creek was a small engagement during the American Civil War that took place January 8, 1865, along Dove Creek in what is now southwest Tom Green County, Texas. Texan soldiers under Confederate captains Henry Fossett and S.S. Totten, misunderstanding which tribe occupied a discovered camp, attacked a tribe of peaceful Kickapoo Indians and were badly beaten by an organized defense.

zh.s: 1865年1月8日，美国内战中的一场小规模战斗在多夫溪沿岸爆发，地点位于今得克萨斯州汤姆格林县西南部。邦联上尉亨利·福塞特和S.S.托滕率领的得克萨斯士兵，误认所发现营地属于其他部落，攻击了和平生活的基卡普人。基卡普人组织防御，使进攻者遭到惨败。

en.t: Congress enacts the District of Columbia Suffrage Act over Andrew Johnson’s veto
en.s: The District of Columbia Suffrage Act became law on 8 January 1867 over President Andrew Johnson’s veto. It removed racial restrictions on men’s voting rights in the District, extending the franchise to African American men.
en.n: This entry records enactment over the veto, not the president’s earlier veto or a nationwide voting-rights law.

zh.t: 美国国会推翻安德鲁·约翰逊的否决，使哥伦比亚特区选举权法案生效
zh.s: 1867年1月8日，美国国会推翻总统安德鲁·约翰逊的否决，使《哥伦比亚特区选举权法》生效。该法取消了特区男性投票权的种族限制，将选举权扩大至非裔美国男性。
zh.n: 此条记录涉及国会推翻否决后法律生效，并非此前总统否决的日期，也并非全国性选举权立法。

en.s: The Battle of Wolf Mountain, also known the Battle of the Wolf Mountains, Miles's Battle on the Tongue River, the Battle of the Butte and called the Battle of Belly Butte by the Northern Cheyenne, occurred January 8, 1877, in southern Montana Territory between soldiers of the United States Army against Lakota Sioux and Northern Cheyenne warriors during the Great Sioux War of 1876. It was fought about four miles southwest of modern-day Birney, along the Tongue River. In 2001, the Wolf Mountains Battlefield was listed on the National Register of Historic Places. It was raised to the status of National Historic Landmark in 2008.

zh.s: 1877年1月8日，在1876年大苏族战争期间，美国陆军与拉科塔苏族及北夏延族战士，在蒙大拿领地南部交战。地点位于今伯尼西南约四英里、唐河沿岸。这场战斗称狼山战役，也称迈尔斯唐河之战或山丘战役，北夏延人则称其为“肚腹山丘之战”。2001年，狼山战场列入美国国家史迹名录，2008年又被指定为国家历史地标。

en.s: On the third day of Serbian Christmas, January 8, 1880, about a month after the battle of Novšiće, around 10,000 pro-Ottoman Albanians attacked the Montenegrin forces numbering 3,000, led by commanders Marko Miljanov and Todor Miljanov and priest Đoko, in Murino. At this battle, the Montenegrin forces were made up of the Bratonožići, Vasojevići and Moračani. The Albanians, among whom were Ottoman regulars (as in previous battles), had 1,400 casualties (dead and wounded), the Montenegrins 36 dead and 70 wounded. According to the Montenegrin Prince Nicholas, the defeat of retreating Ottoman forces was so devastating, that Montenegrin forces finished the battle before the night had fallen, which is something they usually don't do.

zh.s: 1880年1月8日，塞尔维亚圣诞节第三天，距离诺夫希切战役约一个月，约一万名亲奥斯曼的阿尔巴尼亚人进攻穆里诺的3,000名黑山军人。黑山军由马尔科·米利亚诺夫、托多尔·米利亚诺夫及神父焦科率领，部队来自布拉托诺日奇、瓦索耶维奇和莫拉查诸部。与此前战斗一样，阿尔巴尼亚一方也有奥斯曼正规军参战，伤亡共1,400人；黑山一方阵亡36人、受伤70人。黑山亲王尼古拉称，撤退的奥斯曼军队遭受惨败，以至于黑山军在天黑前就结束战斗，这与其通常做法不同。

en.s: The African National Congress (ANC) is a political party in South Africa. It originated as a liberation movement known for its opposition to apartheid and has governed the country since 1994, when the first post-apartheid election resulted in Nelson Mandela being elected as President of South Africa. Founded on 8 January 1912 in Bloemfontein as the South African Native National Congress, the organisation was formed to advocate for the rights of black South Africans.

zh.s: 非洲人国民大会，简称非国大，是南非的一个政党，最初为以反对种族隔离而著称的解放运动。1994年南非举行结束种族隔离后的首次选举，纳尔逊·曼德拉当选总统，此后非国大一直参与执政。该组织于1912年1月8日在布隆方丹成立，原名南非土著人国民大会，旨在争取南非黑人的权利。

en.s: The Battle of Kunfuda Bay was a naval battle of the Italo-Turkish War between small squadrons of the Italian and Ottoman navies. On 7 January 1912, the Italian protected cruiser Piemonte and the Soldato-class destroyers Artigliere and Garibaldino, cruising the Red Sea, discovered six Ottoman gunboats, a tugboat, and a yacht in the harbor at Kunfuda.

en.s: The Action of 8 January 1916 was a naval encounter between the Russian dreadnought Imperatritsa Ekaterina Velikaya and the Ottoman battlecruiser Yavuz Sultan Selim in the Black Sea. After a brief exchange of fire the Ottomans withdrew.

zh.s: 1916年1月8日，俄国无畏舰“叶卡捷琳娜大帝皇后号”与奥斯曼战列巡洋舰“严君苏丹塞利姆号”在黑海交战。双方短暂交火后，奥斯曼军舰撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Sheikh Sa'ad (Turkish: Sağ Sahil) occurred between 6–8 January 1916 during the Mesopotamian Campaign of the First World War. The battle took place along the banks of the Tigris River between the Anglo-Indian Tigris Corps and elements of the Sixth Army in Ottoman Iraq. The engagement was the first in a series of assaults by the Tigris Corps to try to break through the Ottoman lines to relieve the besieged garrison at Kut.

zh.s: 谢赫萨阿德战役于1916年1月6日至8日爆发，是第一次世界大战美索不达米亚战役的一部分。战场位于奥斯曼帝国伊拉克地区的底格里斯河沿岸，交战双方为英印底格里斯军团与奥斯曼第六集团军的部分部队。这是底格里斯军团试图突破奥斯曼防线、解救库特被围守军的一系列进攻中的首场战斗。

en.s: The Great Steel Strike of 1919 was an attempt by the American Federation of Labor to organize United States Steel, the leading company in the American steel industry. The AFL formed a coalition of 24 unions, all of which had grown rapidly during World War I. In the lead role would be the Amalgamated Association of Iron, Steel and Tin Workers (AA) with a five-member steering committee.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1926年1月8日，阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·伊本·沙特成为汉志国王。这一王号早于他后来在1932年获得的沙特阿拉伯国王称号。

en.t: Crown Prince Nguyễn Phúc Vĩnh Thuỵ is crowned emperor of Vietnam, the country's last monarch
en.s: Bảo Đại (Vietnamese: [ɓâw ɗâjˀ], chữ Hán: 保大, lit. "keeper of greatness", 22 October 1913 – 31 July 1997), born Nguyễn Phúc Vĩnh Thụy (chữ Hán: 阮福永瑞), was the 13th and final emperor of the Nguyễn dynasty, the last ruling dynasty of Vietnam. From 1926 to 1945, he was de jure emperor of Đại Nam, which consisted of the French protectorates of Annam and Tonkin within French Indochina, covering the present-day central and northern Vietnam.

zh.t: 皇太子阮福永瑞加冕，成为越南最后一位君主
zh.s: 保大帝本名阮福永瑞，生于1913年10月22日，卒于1997年7月31日，是越南最后一个统治王朝阮朝的第13位、也是最后一位皇帝。“保大”为其年号。1926年至1945年，他在法理上是大南皇帝，统治范围包括法属印度支那的安南和东京两个保护地，即今天越南的中部与北部。

en.s: The anarchist insurrection of January 1933 was an attempted revolution carried out by Spanish anarchists, with the intention of overthrowing the government of Spain and establishing libertarian communism. en.s: The Battle of Khalkhyn Temple (Mongolian: Халхын сүмийн мөргөлдөөн Khalkhyn sümiin mörgöldöön; Chinese: Halhamiao Incident, 哈爾哈廟事件; Japanese ハルハ廟事件 Haruhabyō-jiken) of 1935 was one of the border conflicts between the Soviet Union, Mongolia, Japan and Manchukuo which occurred from 1932 to 1939. The incident took place on the border of Manchukuo and Mongolia near the Buddhist temple of Khalkhyn (Temple of Khalkha), located northeast of Buir Lake in present-day Inner Mongolia, China.

en.s: The 1938 Tschammerpokal final decided the winner of the 1938 Tschammerpokal, the 4th season of Germany's knockout football cup competition. It was played on 8 January 1939 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. Rapid Wien won the match 3–1 against FSV Frankfurt, to claim their 1st cup title.

zh.s: 1939年1月8日，德国足球淘汰杯赛的第四届赛事——1938年度恰默杯——在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行决赛。维也纳快速以3比1击败法兰克福FSV，首次夺得这项杯赛冠军。

en.t: World War II: Philippine Commonwealth troops under the Philippine Commonwealth Army units enter the province of Ilocos Sur in Northern Luzon and attack invading Japanese Imperial forces
en.s: The Commonwealth of the Philippines (Spanish: Mancomunidad de Filipinas; Tagalog: Komonwelt ng Pilipinas) was an unincorporated territory and commonwealth (dependency) of the United States that existed from 1935 to 1946. It was established following the Tydings–McDuffie Act to replace the Insular Government of the Philippine Islands and was designed as a transitional administration in preparation for full Philippine independence. Its foreign affairs remained managed by the United States.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：菲律宾自治邦军队进入吕宋岛北部的南伊罗戈省，进攻日军
zh.s: 菲律宾自治邦是美国的非合并领土及属地政体，存在于1935年至1946年。它依据《泰丁斯—麦克杜菲法案》成立，取代菲律宾群岛岛屿政府，作为为菲律宾完全独立作准备的过渡行政体制。其外交事务仍由美国处理。

en.t: Andrei Zhdanov submits evidence to Finland’s war-responsibility court
en.s: On 8 January 1946, Andrei Zhdanov, chairman of the Allied Commission in Finland, submitted evidence to Finland’s war-responsibility court. It included an interrogation report from German prisoner of war General Erich Buschenhagen about prewar Finnish–German military contacts, and a copy of Hitler’s Operation Barbarossa plan.

zh.t: 安德烈·日丹诺夫向芬兰战争责任法庭提交证据
zh.s: 1946年1月8日，驻芬兰盟国委员会主席安德烈·日丹诺夫向芬兰战争责任法庭提交证据。其中包括对德国战俘埃里希·布申哈根将军的审讯报告，内容涉及继续战争前芬兰与德国军方的接触，以及一份希特勒“巴巴罗萨行动”计划的副本。

en.s: The Battle of Rafah was a military engagement between the Israel Defense Forces and the Egyptian Army in the final stage of the 1948 Arab–Israeli War. It was fought on January 3–8, 1949, just south of Rafah, today in the Gaza Strip. The battle was initiated by Israel as part of Operation Horev, on the backdrop of the Sinai battles just before.

en.s: A referendum on self-determination for Algeria was held in France on 8 January 1961. Self-determination was approved by 75.0% of voters overall and 69.5% in Algeria. The government reported voter turnout of 92.2%. Other sources claim that four out of ten of the individuals in France and Algeria entitled to vote abstained. The referendum was worded as follows: "Do you approve the bill submitted to the French people by the President of the Republic and concerning the self-determination of the populations of Algeria and the organization of the public authorities in Algeria prior to self-determination".

zh.t: 1961年法国就阿尔及利亚自决举行公投
zh.s: 1961年1月8日，法国就阿尔及利亚自决举行公投。全部投票者中75.0%支持，阿尔及利亚地区的支持率为69.5%。政府公布投票率为92.2%，但其他资料称，法国及阿尔及利亚有投票资格者中约四成弃权。公投问题是：“您是否赞成共和国总统提交法国人民的法案，内容涉及阿尔及利亚居民的自决，以及自决前阿尔及利亚公共权力机构的组织方式？”

en.t: Lyndon B. Johnson declares a War on Poverty
en.s: President Lyndon B. Johnson called for a war against poverty in his State of the Union address to the United States Congress on 8 January 1964. He proposed federal and local efforts to improve education, health, housing and job opportunities. The address set out anti-poverty priorities that became part of his Great Society programme.
en.n: This entry records the presidential address, rather than the later passage of the Economic Opportunity Act.

zh.t: 林登·约翰逊宣布向贫困宣战
zh.s: 1964年1月8日，美国总统林登·B.约翰逊在向国会发表的国情咨文中，呼吁向贫困宣战。他提出由联邦与地方共同改善教育、医疗、住房和就业机会。这些反贫困重点后来成为其“伟大社会”计划的一部分。
zh.n: 此条记录涉及总统演说，并非后来通过《经济机会法》的日期。

zh.t: 1969年阿拉伯联合共和国议会选举
zh.s: 阿拉伯联合共和国（今埃及）于1969年1月8日举行议会选举，并于1月13日在13个选区进行第二轮投票。当时该国实行一党制，所有候选人都必须是阿拉伯社会主义联盟成员。

en.s: A series of three terrorist bombings in Moscow on 8 January 1977 killed seven people and seriously injured 37 others. No one claimed responsibility for the bombings, although three members of an Armenian nationalist organization were executed early in 1979 after a KGB investigation and a secret trial. en.s: The 1977 German Supercup was an unofficial edition of the German Supercup, a football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Bundesliga and DFB-Pokal competitions. Gladbach won the match 3–2 to claim the unofficial title.

zh.s: 1977年德国超级杯是一届非正式超级杯足球赛，由上一赛季德甲联赛冠军与德国杯冠军交锋。比赛在汉堡的人民公园球场举行，参赛双方为联赛冠军门兴格拉德巴赫与杯赛冠军汉堡。门兴以3比2获胜，夺得这一非正式冠军。

en.s: The Kegworth air disaster occurred when a Boeing 737-400 crashed on to the embankment of the M1 motorway near Kegworth, Leicestershire, England, while attempting to make an emergency landing at East Midlands Airport on 8 January 1989. British Midland Flight 92 was on a scheduled flight from London Heathrow Airport to Belfast Airport, when a fan-blade broke in the left engine, disrupting the air-conditioning and filling the flight-deck with smoke. The pilots believed that this indicated a fault in the right engine, since earlier models of the 737 ventilated the flight-deck from the right, and they were unaware that the 400 used a different system.

zh.s: 1989年1月8日，一架波音737-400试图在英国东米德兰兹机场紧急降落时，坠落在英格兰莱斯特郡凯格沃思附近的M1高速公路路堤上。英国米德兰航空92号班机当时正由伦敦希思罗机场飞往贝尔法斯特，左侧发动机一片风扇叶片断裂，扰乱空调供气，使驾驶舱充满烟雾。飞行员认为右侧发动机出了故障，因为早期737由右侧发动机向驾驶舱供气；他们不知道400型采用了不同系统。

en.s: Soyuz TM-18 was launched from Baikonur Cosmodrome and landed 112 km north of Arkalyk. TM-18 was a two-day solo flight that docked with the Mir space station on January 10, 1994. The three cosmonauts became the 15th resident crew on board Mir. The crew did research work in space flight medicine, primarily by cosmonaut Valeri Polyakov during his long-term flight, and accomplished 25 different experiments.
en.n: Russian cosmonaut Valeri Polyakov on Soyuz TM-18 leaves for Mir. He would stay on the space station until March 22, 1995, for a record 437 days in space.

en.s: The 1996 Air Africa crash occurred on 8 January 1996 when an overloaded Air Africa Antonov An-32B aircraft, wet leased from Moscow Airways and bound for Kahemba Airport, overshot the runway at N'Dolo Airport in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo after failing to take off and plowed into Kinshasa's Simbazikita street market. Though four of the aircraft's six crew survived, 225 fatalities and around 253 serious injuries occurred on the ground. This is the largest number of non-passenger ground fatalities caused by the accidental crash of an aircraft. According to Russia's Federal Air Transport Agency, the aircraft was operating out of license.

zh.t: 1996年金沙萨非洲航空坠机事故
zh.s: 1996年1月8日，非洲航空一架超载的安东诺夫An-32B，在刚果民主共和国金沙萨恩多洛机场起飞失败，冲出跑道，撞入辛巴齐基塔露天市场。这架飞机连同机组从莫斯科航空湿租而来，原定飞往卡亨巴机场。六名机组人员中有四人生还，但地面225人死亡，约253人重伤。这是飞机意外坠毁造成非乘客地面死亡人数最多的一次事故。俄罗斯联邦航空运输署称，该飞机当时无照运营。

en.t: President of the United States George W. Bush signs into law the No Child Left Behind Act
en.s: The No Child Left Behind Act of 2001 (NCLB) was a 2002 United States act of Congress promoted by the presidential administration of George W. Bush. It reauthorized the Elementary and Secondary Education Act and included Title I provisions applying to disadvantaged students. It mandated standards-based education reform based on the premise that setting high standards and establishing measurable goals could improve individual outcomes in education.

zh.t: 美国总统乔治·W.布什签署《不让一个孩子掉队法》

en.s: Operation Phantom Phoenix was a major nationwide offensive launched by the Multinational Force Iraq (MNF-I) on 8 January 2008 in an attempt to build on the success of the two previous corps-level operations, Operation Phantom Thunder and Operation Phantom Strike and further reduce violence and secure Iraq's population, particularly in the capital Baghdad. The offensive consisted of a number of joint Coalition and Iraqi Army operations throughout northern Iraq as well as in the southern Baghdad Belts. The northern operation was designated Operation Iron Harvest. Its objective was to hunt down the remaining 200 Al-Qaeda extremists remaining in the province of Diyala following the end of the previous offensive.

en.s: A terrorist attack occurred on 8 January 2010 as the Togo national football team traveled through the Angolan province of Cabinda on the way to the 2010 Africa Cup of Nations tournament, two days before it began in Angola. en.s: The La Vega raid was a police raid that occurred on 8 January 2021 in La Vega Parish, Caracas, Venezuela. The objective of the raid was to take control of La Vega Parish, which was controlled by a criminal organization, led by Leonardo José Polanco Angulo; he was a drug lord, known as "El Loco Leo".

zh.t: 委内瑞拉拉维加警方突袭
zh.s: 2021年1月8日，委内瑞拉警方在首都加拉加斯的拉维加区展开突袭，目标是夺回该区的控制权。当地由毒枭莱昂纳多·何塞·波兰科·安古洛领导的犯罪组织控制，他的绰号是“疯子利奥”。

en.s: The Czech Pirate Party held a leadership election on 8 January 2022, following the party's poor performance in the 2021 Czech parliamentary election. Ivan Bartoš was reelected, defeating Senator Lukáš Wagenknecht in the final round.

zh.s: 2022年1月8日，捷克海盗党在2021年议会选举表现不佳后举行党首选举。伊万·巴尔托什在最后一轮击败参议员卢卡什·瓦根克内希特，获得连任。

en.s: The 2022 Hard To Kill was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Impact Wrestling. It took place on January 8, 2022, at The Factory in Deep Ellum in Dallas, Texas. It was the third event under the Hard To Kill chronology. 10 matches were contested at the event, with two matches contested on the pre-show and one match taped as a digital exclusive.

zh.s: 2022年1月8日，Impact Wrestling在美国得克萨斯州达拉斯深埃勒姆区的The Factory，举办第三届“难以击倒”按次付费职业摔角赛。赛事共进行十场比赛，其中两场为赛前节目，另有一场录制后仅在数字平台播出。

en.s: On 8 January 2023, following the defeat of then-president Jair Bolsonaro in the 2022 Brazilian general election and the inauguration of his successor Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, a mob of Bolsonaro's supporters attacked Brazil's federal government buildings in the capital, Brasília.

zh.s: 2023年1月8日，在时任总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗于2022年巴西大选中落败、继任者路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦就职后，一群博索纳罗支持者在首都巴西利亚袭击了巴西联邦政府的办公建筑。

en.s: By-elections for the Tenth Legislative Yuan were held in 2023, one each on 8 January and 4 March, in Taiwan to elect 2 of the 113 members of the Legislative Yuan for the remaining term until 2024. The Democratic Progressive Party flipped a seat from the Kuomintang in Nantou II, and the KMT retained its seat in Taipei III.

en.s: The Dima Hasao Autonomous Council election was held on 8 January 2024. The Dima Hasao Autonomous Council, earlier called North Cachar Hills District Council is an autonomous district in the Indian state of Assam.

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Puntland on 8 January 2024. The president was elected by 66 members of the House of Representatives in the administrative capital Garoowe and were the fifth election since the state's formation in 1998. Preceding the elections, a new Parliament Speaker and Deputy Speaker was held on 4 January 2024, by the 6th Parliament of Puntland.

zh.s: 2024年1月8日，邦特兰举行总统间接选举，由众议院66名议员在行政首府加罗韦选出总统。这是该自治州自1998年成立以来的第五次总统选举。此前，第六届邦特兰议会于2024年1月4日选出了新任议长和副议长。

en.s: On 8 January 2025, an attack was carried out against the presidential palace, known as the Pink Palace, in the Chadian capital N'Djamena by unknown attackers. The 24 attackers attempted to gain entry through a security gate of the presidential palace before being confronted by security forces. Chadian President Mahamat Déby was inside the presidential palace at the time, and he later released a thanking guards for thwarting the attack.

zh.t: 2025年乍得恩贾梅纳总统府遇袭
zh.s: 2025年1月8日，乍得首都恩贾梅纳的总统府“粉红宫”遭不明身份人员袭击。24名袭击者试图从一道安全门闯入，随后遭安全部队阻击。总统穆罕默德·代比当时在总统府内，事后发表致谢，感谢卫兵挫败袭击。
